items.title: Broadcom makes surprising move in battle for AI software
items.summary: The company's VM API project joins the CNCF Sandbox to simplify management of virtual machines and containers.

items.title: Nvidia Gets the Spotlight, but This AI Stock Could Steal the Show in 2027
items.summary: While Nvidia hogs the headlines, Broadcom quietly builds the custom chips that let OpenAI and Google bypass the GPU. The stock has stumbled this year, yet one 2027 setup could flip that story fast. What would it take?

items.title: Nvidia stock sinks 5% as chipmaker investigates CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with alleged Chinese spy
items.summary: Nvidia sank on Monday, while the rest of the chip sector rallied.

items.title: AMD Soars 12% on “Undeniable” Data Center Success per Oppenheimer Upgrade
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAMD shares jumped 12% today after Oppenheimer upgraded the stock to Outperform with a $600 target. Broadcom and GE Vernova also rose in a broad AI infrastructure rebound.

items.title: Broadcom Faltered for a Year, Dropping Nearly 20%: This Wall Street Analyst Team Says 140% Gains Materialize Within 12 Months
items.summary: Broadcom posted record results while its stock slid, and the culprit is not revenue. Margin pressure and a $63 billion financing structure have spooked investors, yet one analyst still sees a path far above the crowd.

items.title: Credo Stock Has a Powerful Growth Story, but Is It Already Priced In?
items.summary: Credo just posted triple-digit revenue growth and its eighth straight earnings beat, yet the stock lost a third of its value in a month. Two big customers and one valuation gap might explain why the market and our model disagree.

items.title: ⚡Flash Heard: Why Nvidia’s Troubles Don’t Spell Doom for the AI Trade
items.summary: The AI boom has seen its top cheerleader tarnished over the weekend by revelations of Jensen Huang’s romantic relationship with a suspected Chinese spy.
